card.name: How-to-take instructions: drink, timing, frequency
card.fires_on: Words inside patient instructions on how or how often to take something, such as drink, taken, day or times in 'three times a day'. Also words in sipping and breath-holding directions.

modes.label: Frequency phrases
modes.description: The last word of a how-often phrase like 'times a day' or 'times daily'.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Apply to affected area 3 to 4<< times>> daily.

modes.label: Manner or timing of taking
modes.description: A word in directions on when or how to take or use something, such as taken at bedtime or drink water.
modes.example: Vitrexyl + Iron is best absorbed when<< taken>> at bedtime.

modes.label: Duration of an action
modes.description: A word in how long to sip or hold a breath.
modes.example: Sip this slowly for 25 to 30<< minutes>>.

card.plain: It lights up on the words in directions that say how, when or how often to take or use something.
